shared_or_similar_visual_information: A series of closely spaced short graduations on a measuring edge.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It gives an angular reading position about the center O. Right image: It marks a linear reading position on the scale labeled in decimeters.
Rationales: The graduations on the curved protractor edge represent angular increments about a center. The graduations on the straight ruler edge represent linear distance along the ruler.
